title: COVID-era staff off/work-from-home rotation - January 2021
summary: A restricted January 2021 staff-days-off workbook documents a COVID-era rotation in which marked days represented either days off or work-from-home days for eligible staff while Rockcastle County remained in a red COVID status. Employee assignments are excluded.

claims.claim: The January 13, 2021 roster states that an 'X' marks a day off or a work-from-home day for employees able to work remotely, while Rockcastle County remained in the red for COVID.

evidence.note: Employee names and individual schedules are excluded.

claims.claim: The roster contains a visible revision date, supporting the interpretation that the COVID staffing schedule was maintained as a revisable operational roster rather than a one-time memo.
The June 2021 rotation-schedule memo is later evidence of a transition back toward normal operations and stricter treatment of missed scheduled office-rotation days.

trigger: COVID community-status/operational conditions require reduced on-site staffing or hybrid work.
prerequisites: Determine which roles can work remotely.
steps: Maintain a staff roster with designated off/work-from-home days.
Use a visible revision date when assignments change.
Distinguish employees who can work remotely from those whose marked day is simply off.
Update or retire the rotation when operational conditions change.
decisions: Whether the public-health trigger remains active.
Whether a role/employee is eligible to work from home on a marked day.
When to transition back to normal in-office scheduling.
exceptions: The source says work from home applies only to those who can do so.
controls: Do not retain named employee schedules in generalized knowledge.
Treat the county-color trigger and remote-work arrangements as historical COVID-era evidence, not current policy.
unresolved_questions: What formal policy authorized the January 2021 work-from-home/off-day rotation?
When exactly was the roster retired or replaced?
What current emergency/hybrid-work scheduling process exists, if any?
automation_candidates: Versioned emergency staffing roster with role-based remote-work eligibility and explicit effective/revision dates.
Automatic retention of schedule-change history without publishing employee rosters into generalized knowledge.

provenance.notes: Employee names and individual work/off assignments remain restricted.
